theorems.name: Submission.bv_ext_ofReal_integral_le_bvVariationOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (W : Set (Rn n)) (v : Rn n → ℝ) (G : Rn n → Rn n) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K G → HasCompactSupport G → tsupport G ⊆ W → (∀ x, ‖G x‖ ≤ 1) → ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in W, v x * Chapter02.euclideanDivergence G x) ≤ Chapter02.bvVariationOn v W
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
